description: This file defines the UtilIO class, which provides utility methods for input/output operations such as reading and writing strings, copying streams, and handling character encodings. It focuses on stream and file manipulations with cross-platform line ending normalization.

classes.name: UtilIO
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for input/output operations, such as copying streams, converting byte arrays to strings with consistent line endings, reading from InputStreams and Readers, and writing strings to streams or files.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from a Reader to an Appendable in chunks using a CharBuffer.

methods.name: readString
methods.description:
Converts a byte array or InputStream or Reader into a string with normalized line endings (
). Overloaded to support different input types and character encodings.

methods.name: writeString
methods.description: Writes a string to a File or OutputStream, normalizing line endings to the platform's line separator.
